def find_pattern(s, pattern, start_index):
    for i in range(start_index, len(s) - len(pattern) + 1):
        if s[i] == pattern[0]:
            match = True
            for j in range(1, len(pattern)):
                if s[i + j] != pattern[j]:
                    match = False
                    break
            if match:
                return i
    return -1

def main():
    input_str = input().strip()
    at_index = find_pattern(input_str, "at", 1)
    modified_str = input_str[:at_index] + '@' + input_str[at_index + 2:]
    dot_index = find_pattern(modified_str, "dot", 1)
    output_str = ""
    start = 0
    while dot_index != -1 and dot_index < len(modified_str) - 3:
        output_str += modified_str[start:dot_index] + "."
        start = dot_index + 3
        dot_index = find_pattern(modified_str, "dot", start)
    output_str += modified_str[start:]
    print(output_str)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
